items.information:
🟥🟨🟩 **¡Bienvenidos al Campeonato Nacional de Bolivia 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
Este año celebramos con orgullo el décimo aniversario desde las primeras competencias oficiales en Bolivia, que dieron inicio a nuestra comunidad. Desde entonces, el cubo ha unido a personas de todas las edades y rincones del país, creciendo hasta convertirse en la gran comunidad que tenemos hoy.
La inscripción está abierta para todas las personas, sin importar edad ni lugar de origen. ¡Ven y sé parte de este evento histórico que marcará un antes y un después en Bolivia!


 🟥🟨🟩 **Welcome to the Bolivia National Championship 2025!** 🟥🟨🟩
This year we proudly celebrate the tenth anniversary since the first official competitions in Bolivia, which marked the beginning of our community. Since then, the cube has united people of all ages and from every corner of the country, growing into the great community we have today.
Registration is open to everyone, regardless of age or origin. Be part of this historic event that will mark a before and after in Bolivia!

items.name: Bengal Cube Open 2025

venue.name: Shree Shyam Mandir Ghusuridham Sabhagar (Hall)
venue.address: 122, Jogendranath Mukherjee Rd, Ghusuri, Howrah, West Bengal - 711107

items.information:
**Participants have to bring their own cube for the event.
Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information.**

* Make sure to be available at the venue at least 30 minutes before your event starts. Late entries won't be allowed to participate.
* Attend the tutorial session if you're new to WCA competitions or unfamiliar with its rules.
* Bring a government ID card for verification if it's your first time participating in a WCA competition.
* Participants are expected to volunteer and will be assigned with roles as judges, scramblers, or runners, with the exception of newcomers.
* Addition of any New Round on spot will be done only under the discretion of the Delegate with consultation of Organising team.

**Non-Veg Food is strictly prohibited in the Venue Premises.**

items.name: Manhattan Mini PM 2025
items.information:
This is a series competition with [Manhattan Mini AM 2025](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ManhattanMiniAM2025). You may only register for and compete in one of the two competitions. If you have already registered (with payment) for Manhattan Mini AM 2025, your registration for this competition will be rejected.
​
Note: Square-1 will be the main event. 3x3 will **NOT** be held at this competition.
​
